takeaways: Verbose JSON, vague errors and brittle syntax make ARM templates hard to maintain and push teams into manual portal fixes.
Those manual fixes cause configuration drift, so templates stop reflecting what actually runs in Azure.
Bicep compiles to ARM but adds concise syntax and reusable modules, including Azure Verified Modules, so start by converting one frequently used template.
hook: ARM templates promise consistent Azure deployments but often deliver JSON sprawl, cryptic errors and configuration drift. This episode shows Azure admins and DevOps teams why Bicep, with its cleaner syntax and reusable modules, makes infrastructure as code simpler and more reliable.
